frozen_rule.reason: neither the improvement nor the regression rule is met

change.label: EXPERIMENTAL — OWNER-SELECTED change; not an investigator-verified finding

findings.title: Comparison facts are only on item detail pages
findings.observed: On Original, agents opened 3.0 item detail pages per task on average (4 runs); on Modified, 0.0 (4 runs).

findings.title: Agents loop between listing and detail pages
findings.observed: On Original, agents returned to a listing page 5.8 times per task and revisited pages 7.0 times per task.

findings.title: Agents enumerate links to discover items
findings.observed: On Original, agents used element search/extraction 4.0 times per task to find item links.

findings.title: Agents look for terms on a separate policy page
findings.observed: Agents visited the hire-terms page 0.8 times per task on Original.

findings.title: Observed difference on the Modified site
findings.observed: Agents took 12.5 steps per task on Original and 6.5 on Modified (48% fewer). Observed only; see the comparison rules for whether it meets the pre-registered criteria.

suggestions.text: Show the attributes agents compare (deposit, minimum hire, delivery) on listing cards or in a comparison table.
Offer sortable or filterable listings by the attributes in question (e.g. sort by deposit), so one page answers the comparison.
Expose the full item list with stable, descriptive links (or structured data) on a single listing page.
State per-item terms (deposit, minimum hire) where items are listed instead of only in general terms.

insights.method: Deterministic rules over the agent telemetry of finished runs (pages, actions, errors). Suggestions are proposals, not measured outcomes.
